newsitem.title: USA: American Oncology sets rights plan.
newsitem.headline: American Oncology sets rights plan.

text.p: American Oncology Resources Inc said Tuesday its board of directors adopted a shareholders rights plan which will expire on May 16, 2007.

The company said in a release that under the plan, rights to purchase shares of a new class of preferred stock will be distributed as a dividend of one right for each share of common stock held of record as of the close of business on June 2, 1997.
American Oncology said the rights are not being distributed in response to any effort to acquire control of the company, and the board of directors is not aware of any such effort.
Each right will entitle holders of common stock to buy one one/thousandth of a share of preferred stock at an exercise price of $55, the company said.
It added that the rights would be exercisable only if a person or group were to acquire or announce a tender or exchange offer for 15 percent or more of the company's outstanding common stock.
